import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd();
+
+def write_project(name, source):
+    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
+    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
+        [package]
+        name="{name}"
+        version="0.1.0"
+
+        [[target.bin]]
+        name="{name}"
+        path="src/main.fzy"
+    '''))
+    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
+    return root
+
+def verify(name, source, expect_rc):
+    root = write_project(name, source)
+    proc = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'verify', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
+    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
+    assert proc.returncode == expect_rc, (name, proc.returncode, payload, proc.stderr)
+    return payload
+
+def build(name, source):
+    root = write_project(name, source)
+    proc = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'build', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
+    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
+    assert proc.returncode == 0, (name, proc.returncode, payload, proc.stderr)
+    assert payload['status'] == 'ok', payload
+    return root
+
+def messages(payload):
+    return [item['message'] for item in payload['items']]
+
+stream_wrapper = verify('stream_wrapper', '''
+    use core.http;
+    fn close_stream(stream: HttpStreamHandle) -> i32 {
+        return http.stream_close(stream)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let stream = http.post_json_stream("https://example.com", "{}")
+        discard close_stream(stream)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 0)
+assert stream_wrapper['errors'] == 0, stream_wrapper
+assert not any('linear value `stream` was not consumed/freed' in message for message in messages(stream_wrapper)), stream_wrapper
+
+task_group_join_wrapper = verify('task_group_join_wrapper', '''
+    use core.thread;
+    fn worker() -> i32 {
+        return 1
+    }
+    fn finish(group: TaskGroupHandle) -> i32 {
+        return task.group_join_all(group)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let group = task.group_begin()
+        discard task.group_spawn(group, worker)
+        discard finish(group)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 0)
+assert task_group_join_wrapper['errors'] == 0, task_group_join_wrapper
+assert not any('linear value `group` was not consumed/freed' in message for message in messages(task_group_join_wrapper)), task_group_join_wrapper
+
+task_group_cancel_wrapper = verify('task_group_cancel_wrapper', '''
+    use core.thread;
+    fn worker() -> i32 {
+        return 1
+    }
+    fn finish(group: TaskGroupHandle) -> i32 {
+        return task.group_cancel(group)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let group = task.group_begin()
+        discard task.group_spawn(group, worker)
+        discard finish(group)
+        return 0
+    }
+''', 0)
+assert task_group_cancel_wrapper['errors'] == 0, task_group_cancel_wrapper
+assert not any('linear value `group` was not consumed/freed' in message for message in messages(task_group_cancel_wrapper)), task_group_cancel_wrapper
+
+artifact_root = build('stream_task_group_artifacts', '''
+    use core.http;
+    use core.thread;
+    fn worker() -> i32 {
+        return 1
+    }
+    fn finish(group: TaskGroupHandle) -> i32 {
+        return task.group_join_all(group)
+    }
+    fn close_stream(stream: HttpStreamHandle) -> i32 {
+        return http.stream_close(stream)
+    }
+    fn main() -> i32 {
+        let group = task.group_begin()
+        discard task.group_spawn(group, worker)
+        discard finish(group)
+        let stream = http.post_json_stream("https://example.com", "{}")
+        discard close_stream(stream)
+        return 0
+    }
+''')
+
+memory_report = json.loads((artifact_root / '.fz' / 'memory-report.json').read_text())
+memory_text = json.dumps(memory_report)
+assert 'group' in memory_text and 'TaskGroupHandle' in memory_text, memory_report
+assert 'stream' in memory_text and 'HttpStreamHandle' in memory_text, memory_report
+
+runtime_contracts = json.loads((artifact_root / '.fz' / 'native-runtime-contracts.json').read_text())
+contracts_text = json.dumps(runtime_contracts)
+assert 'http.stream_close' in contracts_text and 'consume_arg0' in contracts_text, runtime_contracts
+assert 'task.group_join_all' in contracts_text and 'consumes_linear_handle' in contracts_text, runtime_contracts
+
+print('compiler-memory-streams-task-groups-ok')
